title: Uka envidia ukax tukusxänwa
intro: Kawkïr reinotsa jan ukajj kuna qellqatanakatsa jukʼamp nayra sarnaqäwiwa, mä arunjja, envidiasiñat yurir jaqenakan nayrïr jan waltʼäwipawa. Mä almax nayrïr awk taykapan yurir pä wawanakan jilïripawa, mä sullka jilapax jan wali khuyaptʼayasiñ katuqkäna ukxa wali colerat uñjäna. Kunatï qhepat utjkäna ukajj chʼamaka ajlliwinakawa, nayrïr wilajj aka Oraqer wartatäna ukanak jaytawayi. ¿Khitis, juicio ukat sinti arrepentisiñax uk qhanstayasmati?
clues: Nayax nayrïr panin jaqinakat yuritayna, jupanakax aka Uraqin sarnaqapxirïtu.
Mä kutix Allah-ar mä ofrenda lurawayta, ukampis janiw nayat katuqatäkänti.
Jilajan ofrendapajj katoqatäjjänwa, nayan ofrendajasti janiw katoqatäkänti, ukajj janiw aguantañjamäkänti.
Nayaw nayrïr jaqir tukuwayta aka uraqin jiwayañataki, pachpa jilajan jakäwip apt’asa.

Allah jupax aka uraqin lurat mä jaqiruw khitäna —mä ch’iyar jamach’iw uraqin allsuski— kunjams kuntix lurawaykta uk imantañ yatichañataki, ukat janiw kunas qhiparawaykti jan ukasti arrepentisiñakiw qhiparawayta.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
